cues: In epiboly, the small animal cells divide fast and spread down over the yolky cells, like a sock being pulled on.
In emboly, cells roll inwards over the lip of the blastopore and move forward inside.
text: Two movements do the work. In epiboly, the small animal cells divide fast and spread down over the yolky cells, like a sock being pulled on. They become ectoderm. In emboly, cells roll inwards over the lip of the blastopore and move forward inside. They become mesoderm and endoderm.
